title: Fairer per-client traffic handling
summary:
A CDN IP fix improves per-client traffic handling, while the README and polli skill get clearer pointers.

An API reliability fix makes per-client rate limiting and abuse detection use the viewer’s IP rather than a shared CDN address. The change was added without altering the Worker’s IP-resolution behavior.

The README’s Latest News now points to Tomdacat’s Roblox integration and its OpenAI-compatible API with more than 40 models. An older Model Health news entry left the list; the endpoint was not removed.

The polli skill now includes the CLI install command and identifies the `polli` binary, so readers know what to install before following its instructions.
